scope: Read-only PGMaps environmental, climate, hazard, infrastructure, outdoor/forestry and remaining-source family inventory. Local scientific schemas and manifests were inspected selectively; remote services, huge archives and privacy-sensitive records were not comprehensively audited. This fragment proposes no data release or application change.
statusMeaning: Status is usage of the named source family in NHHR Atlas; unused does not mean scientifically unusable, and source-only means source metadata/code/vendor outputs exist without an inspected deployed scientific layer. Basemap pixels and shared toolkit code are not use of these analytical datasets.

entries.next: Choose one necessary family, obtain the official source and validate temporal/geometry semantics before implementing any map.
entries.verificationScope: Planned-layer catalogue inspected only; no source files or scientific rows inspected.

entries.title: BC environmental reporting and ecosystem indicators
entries.grain: Distinct grains: 2018 grizzly unit, ecological drainage unit, and regional-district waste/population indicator.
entries.geometry: 59 grizzly units, 36 ecological drainage units, 29 regional-district attribute records joined to existing census-division geometry.
entries.vintage: Capture 13 August 2026; grizzly edition 2018, waste latest 2023 and population latest 2025.
entries.rights: BC environmental/census source terms apply; preserve per-indicator publisher and source edition.
mapNow: Local native source geometries and regional-district attributes are available.
missing: Register native unit/regional-district IDs and preserve distinct denominators/years.
Review 122 nearest-assigned invasive occurrences; proximity assignment is not a verified exact location.
Do not force ecological/drainage counts into health regions without an explicit crosswalk and valid aggregation.
cannot: Wildlife/invasive/waste indicators are not individual exposure or clinical outcomes.
Waste rates and population changes cannot be averaged without their source denominators.
entries.next: Begin with a labelled regional waste-rate or native ecosystem-context view, keeping each geography and observation year separate.
entries.verificationScope: Manifest source statistics, output identities and regional-district schema/counts inspected; underlying mortality/occurrence rows and assignments not independently validated.

entries.title: Industrial/remediation/disturbance reconstruction inputs
entries.grain: Original industrial site or normalized LHA candidate indicator; reconstruction is separate from regulatory measurements.
entries.geometry: Source inventory includes mines/refineries/oil-gas fields/mills; candidate LHA tables reference selected normalized values.
entries.vintage: Source vintages differ; file names and candidate status do not establish current industrial operations.
entries.rights: NRCan/BC/source-specific terms and original source labels need direct review.
mapNow: Specific independently sourced site geometry may support an environmental context overlay.
missing: Verify exact original source, operational status, coordinates and emission/remediation definitions.
Retain candidate/source-equivalence flags and reviewed aggregation.
cannot: Industrial site presence is not measured pollution, personal exposure, toxic dose or causal disease risk.
entries.next: Acquire one authoritative current/historical site inventory and keep presence distinct from any measured emission indicator.
entries.verificationScope: File presence and research-release source provenance inspected; underlying industrial geometry/measurement records catalogue-only.

entries.title: Terrain, hillshade and flatten/visibility dependencies
entries.grain: DEM tile or modelled viewing station/route; rendered hillshade is not an observation table.
entries.geometry: Remote AWS Terrarium raster DEM and local hillshade; PG/SF graphs are separate routing inputs assigned to the access audit.
entries.vintage: DEM mosaic edition/resolution depends on source/zoom; PG flatten source has OSM/elevation hashes and stated terrain estimates.
entries.rights: AWS terrain/source DEM and graph-engine/OSM licences need separate retention; do not infer a single licence from toolkit code.
mapNow: PGMaps already has terrain/visibility specialist renderers; source DEM availability was not fetched here.
missing: NHHR currently lacks analytical raster DEM/terrain, tile decoding and worker/visibility model interfaces.
Keep missing terrain unknown, source resolution and coordinate registration explicit.
Visibility/access models need their own reviewer assumptions and data coverage.
cannot: Terrain-only visibility is not cellular signal or guaranteed accessibility.
Regional terrain is not LiDAR; bridges/tunnels and missing turn restrictions limit route interpretations.
entries.next: Link the existing specialist tool first; add terrain only for a concrete environmental/access question with preserved resolution, licence and modelling assumptions.
entries.verificationScope: Terrain/source documentation and flatten provenance schema inspected; raster pixels and graph/model outputs not audited.

entries.title: Historical Canadian fallout reporting posts and shelters
entries.grain: Historical archival reporting post/shelter or communication line, approximately circa 1963.
entries.geometry: 1,747 features: 1,439 points and 308 lines; source says shelter locations are approximate.
entries.vintage: KML conversion 14 June 2026; subject period is circa 1963 and contributing map began 2014.
entries.rights: Google My Maps/archival/contributor rights not established by the local KML copy.
mapNow: Historical context can be mapped after archive/source rights and approximate-location review.
missing: Keep historical period, approximate accuracy and provenance with every feature.
No current facility certification or operational data is supplied.
cannot: These are not current emergency shelters, safe destinations or measured radiation levels.
entries.next: Keep outside the clinical Atlas unless a clearly historical research story needs it; link the archival source and mark approximate points.
entries.verificationScope: Summary counts/description inspected; original archival location accuracy and individual records unreviewed.

entries.title: Nechako public research and GIS service showcase
entries.grain: Public research record/location reference, bibliography entry or WMS service/layer metadata; these grains lack a verified common ID crosswalk.
entries.geometry: 1,408 research records; 51 location IDs, 46 mapped locations, 365 unmapped records; 32 WMS services and 135 named layers are catalogue entries.
entries.vintage: Public capture 11 October 2026; saved public projects captured 12 October 2026. Research dates span 12 decades.
entries.rights: Each research attachment, WMS service and bibliography source retains its own rights; public metadata is not a universal GIS-data licence.
mapNow: Public research-reference points and source links can support a separate literature/location explorer.
missing: Verify research-location definitions and deduplicate original identities before joining to NHHR study evidence.
WMS capabilities are metadata; data layers/identify depend on live services and a missing NHHR WMS adapter.
No verified crosswalk exists among research IDs, Zotero keys and portal submission IDs.
cannot: Mapped literature references are not clinical trial sites, participant locations or completed NHHR research.
Named WMS layers do not establish locally available scientific rows.
entries.next: Offer a linked regional research-source catalogue first; only add a bounded public location/reference table after identity and rights review.
entries.verificationScope: Manifest counts/limitations inspected; WMS services, attachments and underlying portal GIS databases not fetched; private submissions were excluded upstream.
